item.title: USD/CAD trades near five-month lows as BoC-Fed policy divergence favours the Loonie
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) holds modest gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, even as the Greenback trades firm amid limited movement as markets drift into holiday mode. At the time of writing, USD/CAD is trading around 1.3675, hovering near its lowest level since July 25.
